project: Intelligent Accounting and Business Management System

criteria.text: Given the Command Center, when it is opened, then every tab is reachable and every card drills down one level.
Given sample mode, when any tab is shown, then the sample data is visibly labelled as sample.

Given the Command Center, when any tab renders, then .colaberry/plan.json and .colaberry/progress.json are both committed in this repo and every tab reads its content from them at runtime rather than from hard-coded values.
Given the Command Center, when any tab is shown, then .colaberry/manifest.json is committed in this repo and every tab shows how old that data is and warns when the age exceeds a week.
Trust — no tab shows a number, a connection or a result the project has not actually produced.
Given a new company setup request, when I enter company details, then the system creates a company profile.
Given an incomplete company setup request, when I try to save, then the system prompts for missing information.
Trust: All company setup actions are logged in the audit trail.
Given a request to add an account, when I provide valid account details, then the system adds it to the chart of accounts.
Given a request to add an account with invalid details, when I try to save, then the system rejects the request.
Trust: All changes to the chart of accounts are logged in the audit trail.
Given a journal entry request, when I enter valid debit and credit amounts, then the system records the entry.
Given an unbalanced journal entry request, when I try to save, then the system rejects the entry.
Trust: All journal entries are logged in the audit trail.
Given a valid transaction, when I post it, then the system updates the general ledger.
Given an invalid transaction, when I try to post, then the system rejects the posting.
Trust: All postings to the general ledger are logged in the audit trail.
Given posted transactions, when I generate a trial balance, then the system displays the balance.
Given no transactions, when I generate a trial balance, then the system shows a zero balance.
Trust: Trial balance generation is logged in the audit trail.
Given a request for financial statements, when I generate them, then the system produces an income statement and balance sheet.
Given incomplete data, when I try to generate financial statements, then the system alerts me to missing information.
Trust: Financial statement generation is logged in the audit trail.

stories.notes: GET /financial-statements aggregates general_ledger by account type into an income statement and balance sheet; rejects with specific reasons when no company profile or no accounts exist; folds current-period net income into equity so Assets = Liabilities + Equity + Net Income holds.

criteria.text: Given a new customer profile request, when I enter valid details, then the system saves the profile.

stories.notes: POST /customers and POST /vendors, each pinning its own type server-side rather than trusting the request body. Duplicate detection uses a (type, name) natural key via a UNIQUE constraint. Writes go through the consolidated recordAuditEvent() helper from the release-boundary retro, not a fresh inline insert.

criteria.text: Given an invoice, when I mark it as paid, then the system updates accounts receivable.
Given a payment error, when I try to process, then the system alerts me to the issue.
Trust: All accounts receivable and payable transactions are logged in the audit trail.

stories.notes: Invoices/bills were built as part of this story since nothing prior created them. Marking paid creates and posts a real, balanced journal entry through the existing STORY-003/004 pipeline (debit cash/credit AR, or debit AP/credit cash) rather than a status flag, directly demonstrating the release's accounting-core integration goal — verified via GET /trial-balance showing the payment. Idempotent re-pay, duplicate invoice_number/bill_number detection, and payment-error alerting (not-found, invalid cash account) all tested.

criteria.text: Given a transaction with balanced debit and credit entries, when I post the transaction, then it should be accepted.
Given a transaction with unbalanced debit and credit entries, when I attempt to post the transaction, then it should be rejected with an error message.
Trust: All transaction attempts must be logged with their success or failure status.

stories.notes: Balanced/unbalanced posting validation already existed from STORY-004. Added logRejectedAttempt() so a rejected posting attempt (not-found or unbalanced) logs a 'transaction_post_rejected' audit entry, closing the gap where only successes were logged. Accounting-period validation from REQ-009's failure-paths list is explicitly out of scope: no acceptance criterion tests it, and no period concept exists in this codebase yet — confirmed with the user rather than assumed.

criteria.text: Given a posted transaction, when I view the audit trail, then it should display the transaction details and status.
Given a failed transaction attempt, when I view the audit trail, then it should display the attempt details and failure reason.
Trust: The audit trail must record every transaction attempt with a timestamp and user ID.

stories.notes: GET /audit-log (entity_type/entity_id filters) derives a success/failure status from the action name and parses details defensively. Added a real user_id column to audit_log (compatibility-mode placeholder: an X-User-Id header, default 'system', pending real auth in a future story) and threaded it through every audit_log write across all six service modules, not just journal-entry/posting events.
